primary_conclusion: Study 002 did not establish a valid economic substitution comparison because the measured P1 observation failed the frozen CD002-QC-1.0 Quality Gate.
methodological_conclusion: The post-hoc diagnostic, itself frozen before use, found that 12 of the 14 rejected fields were nevertheless grounded in the independently frozen public-authority package, and 6 rejected fields exhibited direct public multi-representation conflicts. The P1 task did not explicitly select a JSON-LD block or the Biography Plate fragment. Therefore the frozen Quality Gate failure remains valid, but it must not be interpreted solely as inability of fresh recomputation to reconstruct a uniquely specified state.
economic_conclusion: No Compression Dividend, substitution fraction, or P1-versus-P3 economic comparison is permitted for Study 002 because semantic task equivalence was not established.

p3_measurement.reason_not_run: Study 002 failed to establish an unambiguous quality-equivalent P1 task surface, so additional paid P3 measurement would not support a valid economic substitution comparison.

scientific_interpretation.study_001: Demonstrated that successful x402 payment and HTTP delivery are insufficient when the governed response fails semantic equivalence.
scientific_interpretation.study_002: Demonstrated that even an independently constructed reference and pre-frozen Quality Gate can produce an invalid comparison when the public source corpus exposes multiple plausible state representations and the task does not select one unambiguously.
scientific_interpretation.combined_learning: A valid governed-state benchmark requires both semantic equivalence and representation-selection equivalence before economics may be compared.

recommended_next_study.required_correction: Freeze one independently public state surface before measurement and explicitly identify that surface in the task, such as the canonical Biography Plate JSON-LD node and its public identifier, while still withholding the governed P3 payload.
recommended_next_study.economic_rule: Run P1 and P3 economics only after both satisfy the same pre-frozen quality contract against that explicitly selected public state surface.
do_not_do: Do not retroactively modify Study 002 PASS/FAIL.
Do not reinterpret alternate public representations as Study 002 passes.
Do not run additional paid Study 002 P1 or P3 observations.
Do not tune Study 003 to force governed reuse to win economically.
